newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn coalition agrees 1998 draft budget -fin min.
newsitem.headline: Bonn coalition agrees 1998 draft budget -fin min.

text.p: German Finance Minister Theo Waigel has completed the draft budget for 1998 that includes funding for the Eurofighter military jet, a Finance Ministry spokeswoman said on Wednesday.

"There is a draft for the 1998 budget that conforms to the constitution," the spokeswoman told reporters in Bonn, adding that Waigel would present details of the budget at a news conference on Friday.
"It is correct that the Eurofighter financing is included in the budget planning," she added.
Coalition sources had said on Tuesday that over two billion marks ($1.1 billion) in funding for the four-nation military project was included in the budgets for 1998 and 1999.

The source also said government spending would total 461 billion marks next year. This is higher than the original target of 447 billion marks because of the costs of record unemployment and weak tax revenues.
-- William Boston, Bonn Newsroom, 49 228 26097 150 ($ = 1.759 German Marks)
